verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right (logo, bottle, quote, CTA), but the opening quote mark floats far above the quote line, the bottle is a tiny sliver, the gaps between groups are uneven, and the cropped circle behind the CTA looks like a stray fragment. B jams the CTA pill against the 'MAYA R., VERIFIED BUYER' line so they almost collide and the button reads as part of the attribution. It also leaves dead space on the left and shoves the logo onto the cut-off circle at the far right edge, and its quote mark is detached too.
